title: Bidri art, from my hometown
blurb: A 600-year-old craft from Bidar that was close to disappearing.
detail:
Bidri is a roughly 600-year-old, Persian-influenced metal craft from my hometown, Bidar, in Karnataka. In 2020 it was close to disappearing.

That year I visited a local workshop. I admired the artisans' detailed work, and I felt a pang of guilt for having taken this heritage for granted. As I learned about their financial struggles and the divisions within the community, I realised that if I didn't step up to preserve the craft, no one else might.

I started with one-on-one conversations with key artisans, building trust around shared goals. To make their work more visible, I launched a social media campaign about their craft and their stories. With NGO partners I raised INR 70,000, and I worked with local influencers to widen the reach.

Within six months, revenue rose by 60% for more than 80 artisans, and the community had a renewed sense of pride and unity.
